definitions.gloss: interest rate hike, raising interest rates
definitions.explanation: An increase in interest rates, typically by a central bank as a monetary policy tool. Frequently appears in economic news and financial discussions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日銀|にちぎん}→日銀：19311_nichigin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{利上|りあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: The Bank of Japan decided to raise interest rates.

examples.japanese: {利上|りあ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Mortgage interest rates went up due to the rate hike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧{利上|りあ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}している→注目する：25530_chuumokusuru⟧。
examples.english: The market is watching closely for the possibility of further rate hikes.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利上|りあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}する→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧ (decide to raise rates)
- ⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧{利上|りあ}げ (additional rate hike)
- {利上|りあ}げ⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧ (size of the rate increase)
- {利上|りあ}げ⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧ (rate hike expectations)

USAGE:
The opposite is ⟦{利下|りさ}げ→利下げ：15819_risage⟧ (interest rate cut). In Japanese economic news, {利上|りあ}げ most commonly refers to actions by the {日本銀行|にほんぎんこう} (Bank of Japan) or foreign central banks like the FRB (Federal Reserve). The word is an abbreviation of {金利引|きんりひ}き{上|あ}げ.
